collection.title: Hyundai Kona 2017 to 2023 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Hyundai Kona 2017 - 2023 model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Hook type arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Kona which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
